name: Lviv Cheesecake
description: Lviv Cheesecake, or Lvivskyi Syrnyk, is a lighter, tangy Ukrainian dessert made with fresh cottage cheese (syr) instead of cream cheese, giving it a distinct, fresh flavor, often enhanced with lemon zest, vanilla, and sweet additions like raisins or berries, baked until soft and golden, then usually topped with a rich chocolate glaze and sometimes served with walnuts.

name: Black Forest Éclair
description: This Black Forest Éclair is made with a traditional choux pastry, which contains eggs, butter, flour, and water to create its light, airy texture. It is filled with a rich chocolate pastry cream made from milk, cocoa, sugar, and eggs. Inside, you’ll also find a layer of sweet cherry compote made from ripe cherries. The éclair is topped with fresh whipped cream, dark chocolate shavings, and a cherry glaze. All ingredients come together to deliver the classic Black Forest flavours of chocolate, cherry and cream.

name: Caramel Eclaire
description: A Caramel Éclair made with classic choux pastry – containing eggs, butter, flour, and water – filled with smooth caramel pastry cream made from milk, sugar, butter, and eggs. It is finished with glossy caramel glaze and a light caramel drizzle, creating rich, creamy, and sweet caramel flavour in every bite.

name: Kyiv Cake
description: The Kyiv cake is a legendary Ukrainian dessert known for its contrasting layers of crunchy, nutty meringue and smooth, rich buttercream. Its ingredients typically include meringue layers made with egg whites, sugar, and toasted hazelnuts, a buttercream filling (often a buttercream-style custard), and may also incorporate elements like sponge cake, cocoa powder, and vanilla.

name: Blueberry Basil Eclair
description: This refreshing éclair features a traditional choux pastry shell, which contains eggs, butter, flour, and water, filled with a creamy blueberries, basil, milk, sugar, and eggs, along with a layer of blueberry compote for added flavour. It is finished with a blueberry glaze, fresh basil accents, and an optional touch of whipped cream or white chocolate drizzle, creating a bright and aromatic twist on the classic éclair.

name: Brownie Sampler
description: Our Brownie Sampler features a variety of rich, fudgy brownies made with eggs, butter, sugar, and premium cocoa for that classic chocolatey taste. Each piece may also include chocolate chips, nuts (such as walnuts or pecans), and vanilla extract for extra flavour. These brownies are soft on the inside with a slightly crisp exterior, offering a perfect balance of texture and sweetness. Contains eggs, dairy, and wheat. May contain nuts.

name: Cookie Sampler
description: Our Cookie Sampler is a delicious assortment of freshly baked cookies, including chocolate chip, oatmeal raisin, double chocolate, and peanut butter varieties. Each cookie is made with eggs, butter, wheat flour, sugar, and other natural ingredients, with some containing nuts or chocolate. This sampler offers a perfect mix of chewy, crunchy, sweet, and nutty flavours, making it an ideal treat for sharing or enjoying on your own.

name: Hazelnut Eclair
description: This Hazelnut Éclair is made with classic choux pastry, which contains eggs, butter, water, and flour to create its light and airy shell. It is filled with a silky hazelnut pastry cream made from milk, sugar, roasted hazelnut paste, and eggs for richness. The éclair is topped with a smooth hazelnut glaze, crushed toasted hazelnuts, and a light drizzle of chocolate.

name: Kalu Dodol
description: Kalu Dodol is a traditional Sri Lankan sweet made by slowly cooking kithul jaggery (palm sugar), thick coconut milk, and rice flour until it becomes smooth, glossy, and chewy. It is often flavored with cardamom and mixed with cashews for extra texture. Its rich, dark colour comes naturally from the caramelization of jaggery during the long cooking process.

name: Lemon Raspberry Cake
description: This refreshing Lemon Raspberry Cake is made with soft, moist cake layers that contain eggs, butter, sugar, and flour, infused with fresh lemon zest for a bright citrus flavour. Between the layers is a smooth lemon cream frosting and a vibrant raspberry filling made from real raspberries. The cake is finished with creamy frosting, fresh raspberries, and a light raspberry drizzle, creating a perfect balance of sweet, tart, and fruity flavours.

name: Oeey Gooey
description: Our Oeey Gooey treat is a soft, rich, and ultra-melty dessert made with a buttery base that contains eggs, sugar, flour, and vanilla for its smooth, chewy texture. It is layered with sweetened condensed milk, brown sugar, and melted chocolate to create its signature gooey center. A hint of butter adds extra richness, while a light golden top gives it a warm, caramelized finish. This indulgent treat is perfect for anyone who loves a soft, sticky, melt-in-your-mouth dessert.

name: Peach Lemonade
description: Our Peach Lemonade is a refreshing drink made with fresh lemon juice, ripe peach purée, water, and sugar for natural sweetness. It may also include ice and a touch of mint for extra freshness.

name: Pomegranate Sparkler
description: The Pomegranate Ginger Sparkler is a refreshing, fruity drink made with pomegranate juice, fresh ginger syrup, and sparkling water for a bright, bubbly finish. It is lightly sweetened and may include a squeeze of fresh lemon or lime for extra brightness. This drink does NOT contain eggs, dairy, or any animal-based ingredients. Garnished with pomegranate seeds or a slice of citrus, it offers a crisp, zesty flavour with a warm ginger kick.

name: Raspberry Millie Feuille
description: This Raspberry Mille-Feuille is made with layers of crisp, flaky puff pastry, which contains flour, butter, and salt. The pastry is filled with smooth vanilla pastry cream, made with milk, sugar, vanilla, and eggs for a rich and silky texture. Fresh raspberries are layered throughout, adding natural sweetness and a bright flavour. The top is finished with a light icing glaze or powdered sugar for a classic look.

name: Strawberry Mille-Feuille
description: Our Strawberry Mille-Feuille is made with layers of crisp, buttery puff pastry that contain flour, butter, and salt. The pastry is filled with smooth vanilla pastry cream, which is made from milk, sugar, vanilla, and eggs. Fresh strawberries are layered between the pastry and cream for a bright, fruity flavour. The dessert is finished with a light dusting of icing sugar on top.

name: Chocolate Mille-Feuille
description: Our Chocolate Mille-Feuille is made with layers of crisp, buttery puff pastry, which is prepared with flour, butter, water, and contains no eggs in the pastry itself. Between the pastry layers is a smooth, velvety chocolate pastry cream made from milk, sugar, cocoa, and eggs, giving it a rich and creamy texture. The dessert is finished with a glossy chocolate glaze and a light dusting of cocoa or chocolate shavings.

name: Coffee Caramel Mille-Feuille
description: This elegant pastry features layers of crisp puff pastry, made with flour, butter, and a small amount of egg, providing a light and flaky texture. Between the layers, there is a smooth coffee-flavored pastry cream, which contains milk, sugar, and eggs for richness and creaminess. A decadent caramel sauce is drizzled on top, complemented by a dusting of powdered sugar or chocolate for extra indulgence. Every bite combines the delicate crunch of pastry with the luscious coffee and caramel flavors, creating a refined and irresistible dessert experience.

name: Chocolate Mocha Eclair
description: Our Chocolate Mocha Éclair is made with a light and airy choux pastry, which contains eggs, butter, flour, and water to create its signature puffed texture. It is filled with a creamy mocha chocolate pastry cream, made from milk, sugar, cocoa, coffee, and eggs. The éclair is topped with rich chocolate ganache and a dusting of cocoa powder, providing a perfect blend of coffee and chocolate flavours. Every bite delivers the indulgent taste of chocolate and mocha, with a smooth, creamy texture.

name: Raspberry Negroni
description: The Raspberry Negroni is a refreshing, fruit-forward twist on the classic cocktail. It contains gin, sweet vermouth, Campari, and fresh raspberry puree, shaken and served over ice with a twist of orange for garnish. The result is a perfectly balanced drink with a bold, bittersweet flavor and a hint of fresh berry sweetness.

name: Strawberry Soda
description: A refreshing and fizzy drink made with sparkling water, strawberry syrup or puree, and a touch of sweetener (sugar or natural alternative). It may also include lemon juice for a hint of tang. This beverage does not contain eggs, dairy, or gluten, making it a light and safe option for most diets. Served chilled, it’s a sweet, bubbly treat bursting with fresh strawberry flavour.

name: Triple Chocolate Cake
description: Our Triple Chocolate Cake is a decadent treat for chocolate lovers. It features moist chocolate sponge layers made with flour, sugar, cocoa, butter, and eggs. Between the layers is a rich chocolate ganache filling, crafted from dark chocolate and cream, and the cake is topped with a smooth chocolate frosting and chocolate shavings for extra indulgence. This cake contains eggs and dairy and delivers an intense, triple-chocolate experience in every bite.

name: Undu Walalu
description: Undu Walalu is a traditional Sri Lankan sweet made from urad dal (black gram lentils), coconut, jaggery or sugar, and rice flour. It is deep-fried to a golden brown, resulting in a crisp exterior and soft, slightly chewy interior. This version does not contain eggs or dairy, making it naturally vegetarian. The combination of lentils, coconut, and jaggery gives it a rich, nutty, and sweet flavor, perfect as a snack or festive treat.

name: White Hot Chocolate
description: Indulge in our creamy White Hot Chocolate, made by melting rich white chocolate into steaming hot milk for a smooth and velvety drink. It’s topped with fluffy whipped cream and delicate white chocolate shavings for an extra touch of sweetness. This comforting beverage contains milk and dairy, making it a perfect treat for those looking for a warm, sweet indulgence.

name: White Strawberry Brownie
description: A soft and indulgent brownie made with white chocolate and fresh strawberries. The base is crafted from butter, sugar, flour, and eggs, giving it a rich, moist texture. Mixed into the batter are chunks of strawberries and white chocolate pieces, creating bursts of fruity sweetness and creamy chocolate in every bite. Topped with a light white chocolate drizzle and fresh strawberry slices, this dessert combines sweetness, freshness, and a melt-in-your-mouth texture.
